The '''Shwuy Exchange''' was a minor [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that passed through [[Ord Antalaha]], and connected the [[Shwuy sector/Legends|Shwuy sector]] to the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].
